spans.s: अदृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Invisible, unobserved; 2. unforeseen; 3. unfelt.
अदृष्ट (II) n. 1. An unforeseen danger; 2. destiny, fate; 3. virtue or vice as the eventual cause of pleasure or pain.
अदृष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Invisible, unobserved; 2. unforeseen; 3. unfelt.
अदृष्ट-अर्थ a. having an object not evident to the senses, metaphysical.
अदृष्ट-फल a. having consequences that are not yet visible.
अदृष्टि a. A malicious look, an evil eye.
आदृत a. (f. ता) 1. Honoured, respected; 2. respectful.
आदृत a. (f. ता) 1. Honoured, respected; 2. respectful.
